sloka: समुद्रात्पश्चिमात्पूर्वं दक्षिणादपि चोत्तरम् ।क्रामत्यनुदिते सूर्ये वाली व्यपगतक्लमः ॥४-११-४॥।।
transliteration: samudrātpaścimātpūrvaṁ dakṣiṇādapi cottaram ।krāmatyanudite sūrye vālī vyapagataklamaḥ ॥4-11-4॥।।

translations.english: 'In the early hours before Sunrise Vali crosses over the oceans from the west to the east and moving from south to north (performing sandhya) without getting fatigued.
